result.headline: Human Written
result.prediction: We believe that this entire text is human-written.
result.text: I still wouldn't move in too fast if I can avoid it, and I'd pick a date to check in before a crisis. I'd also try to make some real friends together. My friends are going to hear me first and hers are going to hear her first. That's normal; they're our friends. The problem is when every person around the relationship only knows one of us well. Then the first serious conflict turns into two teams arguing about two different relationships.
